task_description: Build the primary KG drug->ADR association-prediction research experiment under research/kg/: reproducible knowledge-graph build to Parquet with SHA-256 provenance; leakage-controlled drug-wise/term-wise/random splits with a zero-overlap unit test; classical baselines (popularity, similarity-kNN, logistic regression, matrix factorisation); a lazy-imported heterogeneous GNN; metrics (AUROC/AUPRC/P@k/ECE) with bootstrap CIs over held-out drugs; ablation matrix and error analysis; score export to data/model/assoc_scores.parquet plus MODEL_CARD.md; a single run_all.py that degrades gracefully when torch/RDKit/matplotlib are absent; requirements.txt and METHODS/PROCESS/README docs. Model output is research-only and must never feed the deterministic engine or set a rule category. Do not modify engine/, frontend/, or research/models/.
